div.p: Hayward Lane North is located between Russell and Exhibition streets, extending between Little Lonsdale Street and La Trobe Street. Hayward Lane North was home to some contrasting business types in 1895. On the eastern corner of Little Lonsdale Street and Hayward Lane North was a Brass Foundry building, whilst at the opposite end of the lane was the Supreme Court Hotel.
